**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2**

- **Issue:** Section 2.2 ("Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term") imposes an exclusivity/field-of-use restriction on us, restricting the analytics services we may buy or build. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Silverline acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** delete Section 2.2; Section 12.3's disclaimer then governs.
- **Fallback offered in the comment:** a narrow restriction tied to a single named competing product, during the term only (max 12 months), with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
- Note: other Customer-side restrictions spotted (Section 12.4 eighteen-month no-hire, Section 7.2 MFN) are outside this rule and should be picked up by the no-hire/MFN rules.
